fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2026-08-05, the complainant left a grey scooter bearing registration number TN-30-YY-1052 near Sevvanthi Colony Bus Stand Area and could not find it later. The time of the incident was given as 04:30 on 2026-08-05. Udhay Ramasamy approached Vellore Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000368. Yuvaraj Natarajan (mobile 9000000298) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant mentioned a vehicle observation. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00389, as the mobile number 9000000298 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly taken after the handle lock was forced.
fields.Keywords: scooter theft, vehicle, vehicle observation, suspect, mobile number, early morning, bus stand, scooter
